Dalayna Hewitt (born December 16, 2000) is an American tennis player. Hewitt has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 383, reached on 6 May 2024. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 160, achieved on 25 November 2024. [ 1 ] Hewitt made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2022 Tennis in the Land in Cleveland, after qualifying for the singles tournament, losing to Sofia Kenin in the first round. [ 2 ] She also received a wildcard for the doubles main draw with Peyton Stearns . [ citation needed ] Partnering Robin Anderson , Hewitt was runner-up at the 2024 Calgary Challenger , a W75 event, losing in the final to Kayla Cross and Maribella Zamarripa in a champions tiebreak.
